summary: 3DNow! SIMD interpolation between four packed float control points (a2..a5) parameterized by scalar factor a6, storing two result lanes into output a1. Broadcasts a6, derives a set of higher-order weight coefficients with packed multiply/add/sign-flip operations, blends the first packed element of all four inputs, blends the low 32-bit lanes of each input's second element, scales both results by 0.5f (packed 0x3F0000003F000000), emits EMMS, and returns a1.

operations.description: Broadcast scalar factor a6 into packed 32-bit lanes via cvtsi32_si64 and punpckldq, constructing the t and 1.0f operands (v6, v7, v8).

Derive weight coefficients from t: powers (t^2, t^3), packed differences, a sign flip via xor with 0x8000000000000000, and a scale by packed [2.0f, 3.0f], producing the four coefficient lanes held in v15/v16 and duplicated across v17/v18/v19/v21.
Blend the first packed element of the four control points: v22 = w0*a2[0] + w1*a3[0] + w2*a4[0] + w3*a5[0] using packed pfmul/pfadd.
Blend the second element using the low 32-bit lanes of a2[1], a3[1], a4[1], a5[1]: v23 = w0*a2[1].lo + w1*a3[1].lo + w2*a4[1].lo + w3*a5[1].lo.
Scale the first blend by 0.5f (packed 0x3F0000003F000000) and store the full 64-bit pair at a1[0].
Scale the second blend by 0.5f and store its low 32-bit lane at a1[1].m64_i32[0] via cvtsi64_si32.

Reads four SIMD constant globals qword_5AF900, qword_5AF910, qword_5AF920, qword_5AF968; in the decompiled source these appear folded into inline __m64 literals, so the per-global constant identity is not recoverable from the packet.
Emit 3DNow! EMMS (_m_femms) to clear the MMX/3DNow state before returning.
